naka.title: First Japanese Embassy to Europe 1586.png
naka.ImageDescription: German leaflet (Flugblatt) 'newspaper' (Newe Zeyttung) describing a Japanese "embassy" organized by the Society of Jesus. Title: 'Newe Zeyttung auss der Insel Japonien'. The Japanese members were carefully selected sons of Japanese noblemen: (top, from left to right) Julião Nakaura, Father Diogo de Mesquita, Mancio Ito, (bottom) Martinão Hara, Miguel Chijiwa. This leaflet was printed in Augsburg (Germany) in 1586 shortly after the 'embassy' stayed in Milan. The highlight of their journey through catholic Europe was an audience in Rome.  This copy is kept by Kyōto University (Kyōto, Japan).
